title: Kit Green ran the CIA's 'weird desk'

tellings.quote: He ran the CIA's quote unquote weird desk for a long period of time.

plain: A man named Kit Green ran the CIA's so-called "weird desk" for a long time, Jesse Michels says, meaning the spot at America's foreign spy agency that handled strange subjects. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, while talking with the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for odd events. It would mean the CIA kept someone on hand just for the unexplained.
